game_lines_rule: The 15 biggest PRICE differences on the board, one per game, richest first — how much more the best book pays than a typical one on the SAME wager. ⚠️ This is not a prediction and it does not say who wins. It is arithmetic on 84 quotes that 3+ of the five books priced at the identical signed number. Football carries no Gizmo's rating and no row here has one.
